desc: Ideate and select algorithm: bad pairs are same left endpoint, same right endpoint, or same-direction proper crossing; use backward first-hit report-delete sweep.
Implement input parsing/normalization, same-endpoint predecessor scan, and query answering.
Implement report-delete segment tree with compressed x, max-y tree, leaf heaps, strict bounds, and insert/report/delete.
Run crossing sweeps for both signs in original and mirrored coordinates, updating p with the maximum crossing predecessor.
Build prefix maxima of p and answer queries as Yes iff pref[R] < L with fast I/O.
Validate on provided samples (passed) and confirm edge cases (single person, touching intervals, strict bounds) are handled.
